references.text: Parallel verse that also mentions sea creatures without fins and scales as detestable (שֶׁקֶץ)
Uses the same terminology for detestable (שֶׁקֶץ) animals, here regarding birds
Mentions unclean animals and the prohibition against eating detestable things
Repeats the law that sea creatures without fins and scales are unclean and must not be eaten
Ezekiel mentions that he has never eaten carrion (נְבֵלָה) or detestable meat
Elaborates on the prohibition against eating detestable animals and becoming unclean through them
General prohibition against eating anything detestable
Law concerning one who eats carrion (נְבֵלָה) and the consequences of this
